EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns hurrying about their daily business. But amidst the chaos, a sense of unease settles over the land. The king, a stout and proud man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, his eyes fixed on a strange and wondrous object in front of him.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, KING ARTHUR, gazes upon a sleek, silver laptop, its screen glowing with an otherworldly light. He reaches out a trembling hand and touches the keyboard, and suddenly the room is filled with the sounds of distorted, slowed-down electronica.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisor, SIR LANCELOT)
Behold, my friend! The future of our empire!

SIR LANCELOT
(stunned)
Your Majesty, what sorcery is this?

KING ARTHUR
(excitedly)
I have discovered the secrets of... of... (he consults a dusty old tome)...Vaporwave!

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The king's advisors and courtiers look on in confusion as the kingdom's aesthetic begins to transform. The stone walls are now adorned with garish, neon-colored murals, depicting scenes of futuristic cities and alien landscapes. The knights' armor is replaced with sleek, metallic jumpsuits, and the ladies' gowns are now flowing, iridescent robes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors, who are all wearing the latest in vaporwave fashion. The room is filled with the sounds of distorted, slowed-down music, and the air is thick with the scent of incense and ozone.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisors)
We shall call this new era... the Vaporwave Empire!

SIR LANCELOT
(skeptically)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional values? Our chivalry, our honor?

KING ARTHUR
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so last season. We shall forge a new path, one of... of... (he consults his tome again)... retrofuturism!

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape, with vaporwave-inspired architecture and a population of knights and ladies in futuristic, neon-colored attire. The camera pans up to reveal a massive, glowing screen hovering above the city, displaying a never-ending loop of distorted, slowed-down images.

KING ARTHUR
(to the camera)
Welcome to the Vaporwave Empire, where the past and the future collide in a swirl of color and sound.

FADE TO BLACK.
